descriptionInUI: The fleet's anti-ship missiles, made finite. With the stagger on, warships spawn on ReturnFire and are released to weapons-free one group at a time, so a fleet that out-ranges the theatre develops the exchange instead of emptying its tubes in the first minute -- and still defends itself while it waits. With magazines on, every missile fired is charged to that group's campaign stock, a group that runs dry falls back to ReturnFire, and the expenditure is reported for the turn debit; there is no rearm. Land-attack shots are left to the cruise-missile plugin, so nothing is charged twice. Inert unless one of the two naval settings is on and a naval group exists.
